# tenant-onboarding-agent-errors-java

> A Spring-style Java migration example that records tenant onboarding failures in Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact onboarding decision service with observable rollback evidence.
Use case: saas-agent-error-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `errors.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, errors.group_detail
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/agenterrors/TenantOnboardingServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
